subject: BrightLoop — short handoff for high-usage walkthrough
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@brightloop.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLoop — short handoff for high-usage walkthrough

Hi Amy,

Congrats — I noticed BrightLoop Core crossed our self-serve usage threshold yesterday (~250k tokens/day on a single API key). That typically signals teams are hitting the performance sweet spot and benefit from a short, focused walkthrough to surface quick wins (batching, KV caching, routing to cheaper model variants).

Would BrightLoop be open to a 20–30 minute handoff next week so we can:
- run through a lightweight inference checklist,
- validate latency/cost profile on your common paths, and
- align on a quick mutual action plan to reduce token spend by ~20% if applicable.

Suggested slots (PT):
- Tue 14 Sep — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 14 Sep — 13:00–13:30 PT
- Wed 15 Sep — 10:00–10:30 PT

If none of those work, tell me one window that does and I’ll accommodate. Here’s a quick scheduler if you prefer direct pick: https://cal.com/redwood/15min

I attached a one-page checklist so your team knows what we’ll cover. I’ll keep it tightly scoped.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: redwood-quick-demo-checklist.pdf

From: Amy Chen <amy@brightloop.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLoop — short handoff for high-usage walkthrough

Jonas — thanks for the heads up. We did see the bump this morning; good catch.

A quick walkthrough sounds useful. We prefer 30 minutes so we can include our product manager (Derek Park) and someone from infra. Derek is cc’d here.

Of your three slots, Wed 15 Sep 10:00–10:30 PT works best for us. If possible, can you make that 30 minutes (10:00–10:30 PT) instead of 20? We have a short checklist to run on our side as well.

I’ve attached a 1-pager on our current staging setup so you have context.

—Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Product — BrightLoop Analytics
amy@brightloop.com | (212) 555-4820

Attachment: brightloop-prod-overview.pdf

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 18:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLoop — short handoff for high-usage walkthrough

Perfect — Wed 15 Sep 10:00–10:30 PT is booked on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute slot.

I’ve looped in Soojin (solutions engineering) to handle any low-level inference tuning and Lauren (AM) for mutual action plan next steps. I’m attaching a short meeting map we’ll use to keep the session outcome-oriented.

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m intro + goals from BrightLoop
- 5–15m quick profile: common request shapes + latency/cost numbers
- 15–25m targeted recommendations (batching, prefix cache, model/quantization options)
- 25–30m action items and next steps (owner + timeline)

If Derek or the infra person wants to share any access notes beforehand (API key scope, sample payloads), send them over — otherwise we’ll walk through with staging snippets.

See you Wednesday.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-meeting-map.pdf

—Soojin

One ask: can you include in the invite a short checklist link and the HubSpot record so our procurement lead can see the expected next steps? Our procurement usually wants a quick SOW summary ahead of expansions.

Thanks — Amy
